blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Nordel
Delta Gardens — 11501 84 Avenue (also listed as 11507 84 Avenue)

Current MLS listings describe apartment units at this address as built in 2020, in a 5-level building, steps to the North Delta Recreation Centre, parks, shopping and transit; one ground-floor listing notes quartz counters, stainless appliances and a private covered patio, and a top-floor listing notes two side-by-side parking stalls for that unit.
The Residences at Sunstone Village — 8360 Delsom Way

Apartment residences in the Sunstone master-planned community; current listings describe 2-bedroom-plus-den apartment units at this address as built in 2019, with in-suite laundry, a storage locker and underground parking. Do not confuse this building with the separate 70-unit Sunstone rental apartments for residents 55+, which are rental product, not condos for sale.
Streets, schools and getting around Nordel

items.t: Where the condo stock concentrates: (1) the 84 Avenue corridor at the Social Heart — Delta Gardens at 11501/11507 84 Avenue, beside the North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue; (2) the Sunstone pocket at Nordel's south side — The Residences at Sunstone Village at 8360 Delsom Way, the only apartment condos inside the Sunstone master-planned community.

Nordel holds North Delta's civic core: North Delta Recreation Centre (11415 84 Avenue), George Mackie Library (8440 112th Street), North Delta Community Park (11311 84 Avenue) and the North Delta Public Health Unit (11245 84 Avenue) are all in Nordel.

Transit: route 312 runs Scottsdale Exchange to Scott Road Station via 112 Street, and route 391 runs Scottsdale Exchange to Scott Road Station via 116 Street, both with stops at Nordel Way and both connecting to the Expo Line at Scott Road Station.

blocks.text: Good to know about Nordel

items.t: Sunstone's condos were marketed as a one-off: the 2016 launch report states the 54 Sunstone Village Residences condominiums "are the first and will be the only condominiums available in all of Sunstone" — everything else in the master plan is townhomes, single-family homes by Polygon/Morningstar, or the 70 rental apartments.

The Sunstone land play is much bigger than the condo building: a LoopNet overview describes Delsom Estates as a 100-acre master-planned community of eight multi-family developments with 650–700 multi-family units and 178 single-family homes, with Sunstone Village at its entrance at Delsom Way, Delsom Crescent and 84th Avenue.

Delta Gardens is two products under one name: apartment units on 84 Avenue and ground-level townhomes on 115 Street share the Delta Gardens name and the 2020 build year in listings — a search filtered to "condos" alone will silently drop half the complex.

The Social Heart is a permit area, not just a nickname: ND12's stated objective in the 2024 OCP is to revitalize Nordel as the community focus for North Delta, and the two active applications at 112 Street (82 Avenue and 84 Avenue) sit inside it — the blocks around Delta Gardens are the designated intensification core for all of North Delta.

Nordel's west edge is a protected bog: Delta Nature Reserve access is at 10388 Nordel Court — the publicly accessible part of Burns Bog, protected as the Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area — which caps development on that edge and is the green backdrop for the area's west-side streets.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Nordel
Cardinal Pointe — 10605 Delsom Crescent. Strata townhouse
Built 2009 per current listings, which record Title to Land: Freehold Strata, sub-type Townhouse, 3 storeys, by Polygon, with access to the 12,000 sq ft Sunstone Club across the complex.
Eclipse at Sunstone — 10489 Delsom Crescent. Strata townhouse
Built 2011 per current listings (Polygon), 3-storey townhouse sub-type, with Sunstone Club access.
Equinox — 10415 Delsom Crescent. Strata townhouse
Built 2011 per listing records (Polygon, Sunstone), townhouse sub-type, with the Sunstone Club amenity structure.
Capella — 10595 Delsom Crescent. Strata townhouse
Built 2012 per current listings, which record a monthly strata fee and describe a duplex-style townhouse in Polygon's Sunstone community.
Lakeside — 10500 Delsom Crescent. Strata townhouse

Built 2014 per current listings, which record Ownership Type: Freehold Strata (Polygon, Sunstone), with Sunstone Club access. One earlier listing for the complex records built 2010 — year in conflict between listings; the 2014 figure carried by the current listings is used and the conflict is noted.
Delta Gardens townhomes — 8447 115 Street. Strata townhouse
Same complex name, two forms — a search filtered to "condos" alone silently drops the townhouse half.
Kaleido — 10735 84 Avenue. Strata townhouse
Built 2015 per current listings (Polygon), which record a monthly strata fee and exclusive access to the 12,000 sq ft Sunstone Club (outdoor pool, gym, basketball court, lounge).
Sunbury Terrace — 8376 Centre Street. Strata townhouse (bare-land strata plan)

Built 1989 per current listings, which record Title to Land: Freehold Strata and describe a boutique bare-land strata community of just 12 units, designed like half-duplexes; a directory record for the complex gives Strata Plan NWS2806 (secondary source). It is counted because the form is genuinely townhouse-form strata — the bare-land plan type is stated explicitly so no buyer mistakes it for a conventional townhouse strata or for a detached bare-land strata. One listing describes "no strata rules" for the complex.
Streets, schools and getting around Nordel

items.t: The core is the ND12 Nordel Social Heart Development Permit Area in the 2024 OCP, centred on 84 Avenue and 112 Street, running roughly from 86 Avenue toward the 82 Avenue blocks between 112/114 Streets and 116 Street.

Civic core: North Delta Recreation Centre, 11415 84 Avenue; George Mackie Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 8440 112th Street; North Delta Community Park, 11311 84 Avenue; North Delta Public Health Unit, 11245 84 Avenue — all in Nordel.

Roads and transit: Nordel Way runs east–west toward the Highway 91 interchange and the Alex Fraser Bridge; 112 Street and 116 Street run north–south; 84 Avenue is the central east–west street. Route 312 runs Scottsdale Exchange to Scott Road Station via 112 Street and route 391 via 116 Street, both with stops at Nordel Way and both connecting to the Expo Line at Scott Road Station.

Schools: SD37 catchments are address-based. A Sunstone (Delsom) address can differ — one Sunstone townhome listing names Gray Elementary and Sands Secondary — so every address must be run in the locator.

North Delta community-level Condos & Townhomes median was $622,500 in September 2026 ($479/sq ft, 98% sale-to-list, 48 days on market); SnapStats publishes no townhome-only figure and no sub-area median.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Nordel

items.t: Form B diligence (all 11 complexes are strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. For Sunstone complexes, the Form B is also where the Sunstone Club cost-sharing shows up.

Delta property taxes and utilities: 2026 taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on balances outstanding after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 2, 2026; the approved 2026 Financial Plan included a 2.9% property tax increase for City operational services. Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home, covering garbage/recycling and, where applicable, water and sewer.
Flood / Burns Bog edge: the west edge borders the Delta Nature Reserve / Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area (access 10388 Nordel Court).

blocks.text: Good to know about Nordel

items.t: Sunstone's condos were marketed as a one-off, which is why this pocket is townhouse-heavy: a 2016 launch report states the 54 Sunstone Village Residences condominiums "are the first and will be the only condominiums available in all of Sunstone" — everything else in the master plan is townhomes, single-family homes by Polygon/Morningstar, or the 70 rental apartments.

The Sunstone land play is much bigger than any one complex: a LoopNet overview describes Delsom Estates as a 100-acre master-planned community of eight multi-family developments with 650–700 multi-family units and 178 single-family homes, with Sunstone Village at its entrance at Delsom Way, Delsom Crescent and 84th Avenue.

Nordel's west edge is a protected bog, not future lots: Delta Nature Reserve (access 10388 Nordel Court) is the publicly accessible part of Burns Bog, protected as the Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area — west-edge lots border a conservation area, with the development-permit and setback checks that come with it.

blocks.text: Nordel home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

17 townhomes sold in Nordel with a median price of $825,000 (the middle half sold between $810,000 and $925,000), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $551 per square foot, a median year built of 2011 and a median strata fee of $424 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Nordel?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Nordel had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Nordel a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 11 condos and townhomes sold in Nordel over those 5 months, out of 42 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Are pets allowed at Delta Gardens or Sunstone Village Residences?

A shared club structure: a Kaleido townhome listing describes exclusive access to the 12,000 sq ft Sunstone Club with outdoor pool, gym, basketball court and lounge — part of a Nordel strata fee in Sunstone buys into that shared amenity structure rather than an in-building gym alone.
faq.q: What does the Sunstone amenity package actually rest on?

faq.a: A townhouse — current listings classify its units as Row / Townhouse, 3 storeys, built 2017.
faq.q: Is Delta Ridge a condo or a townhouse?

faq.a: In part, a shared club: listings for Kaleido and the other Sunstone collections describe exclusive access to the 12,000 sq ft Sunstone Club with outdoor pool, gym, basketball court and lounge — part of a Sunstone fee buys into that shared amenity structure rather than an in-building gym alone. The exact cost split is on the Form B.
faq.q: What does a Sunstone strata fee actually buy?

faq.a: Only one building in it: the 70-unit Sunstone 55+ Apartments at 10775 Delsom Crescent are rental product for residents 55+. The strata townhomes and condos around it carry no published 55+ bylaw.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Nordel sell for?
faq.a: 17 townhomes sold in Nordel between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $825,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Nordel?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.8% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
